title: docs(adr): ADR-0143 — outbound connector auth is open tier: OAuth2 grants, vendor app-credential exchange and request signing in one declarative auth contract

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9BaU5Bf8FsJVKEf1GxktFtv)_
Refs #26768
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增 ADR-0143(Proposed),把出站连接器认证整体放进开源层:OAuth2(authorization_code+PKCE+刷新、client_credentials)、飞书/钉钉/企业微信应用凭证换 token、请求签名 `signed`(封闭方案枚举);并在 ADR-0015/0018/0022/0023/0024/0097 追加带日期的修订注记(只追加,不改写原文),重新生成 ADR 索引。
- 为什么改:落实「OAuth 放开源层，先起草 ADR 修订」和「建议 1+2立卡」;#26702、#26710 的 spec/运行时/控制台切片都卡在这份记录上。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档,无代码、无 spec 变更;四个决定未答前不应合并。回滚即撤掉本 PR。注意 ADR-0015 原文其实从没划过 OAuth/企业版这条线,注记里如实写明。
- 先看:① `docs/adr/0143-outbound-connector-auth-is-open-tier.md` 的「Decisions put to the maintainer」四问(Q1 连接归属与执行身份、Q2 存储复用 better-auth account 还是独立连接对象、Q3 首批产品、Q4 首批签名方案);② 同文件 D1(哪些从企业版移出、哪些不动);③ `docs/adr/0097-declarative-connector-instances.md` 两条注记。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors && pnpm check:adr-index`,预期两条都 0 退出、无 0143 相关告警。
- 需要你做的:在 ADR 里回答四个决定并批准

## What changes

- **New `docs/adr/0143-outbound-connector-auth-is-open-tier.md`** (Proposed). It decides, in one record:
  - D1, the tier move: outbound connector auth is open tier. Vault backends, curated or paid catalogs, marketplace and sandboxed stdio keep their placement.
  - D2, three closed authored variants: `oauth2` (`authorization_code` with mandatory S256 PKCE and refresh, `client_credentials`, MCP authorization discovery), `app-credential` (`feishu` / `dingtalk` / `wecom`) and `signed` (a closed scheme enum; a member enters only with its signer and vendor vectors).
  - D3: secrets stay `credentialRef`, and tokens live in an encrypted connection record, never in metadata.
  - D4: grant-bearing kinds resolve per dispatch, refreshing on expiry and once on a 401 with single-flight refresh. A revoked grant degrades the instance with a reason and never fails boot.
  - D5: a server-side Connect flow. D6: a grant is never a sign-in method. D7: the unused runtime `ConnectorOAuth2Schema` goes to the spec slice under ADR-0087.
  - The four maintainer decisions are stated as open questions, each with options and a recommendation, and none is decided: Q1 connection ownership / execution identity (rec. organization-shared), Q2 storage (rec. a dedicated connection object, with measured reasons `sys_account` does not fit), Q3 first products (rec. HubSpot MCP, Feishu, Alipay v3 sandbox), Q4 first signing schemes (rec. `alipay-rsa2`, `aliyun-acs3-hmac-sha256`, `tencentcloud-tc3-hmac-sha256`).
- **Dated, append-only amendment notes** (each adds an `**Amended by**:` header line and a blockquote; no existing line changes):
  - ADR-0015: attribution only. It never drew the split others cite it for.
  - ADR-0018 "Out of scope (deliberately not baseline)": where the connector line was first drawn.
  - ADR-0022 §4: the connector half moves. The `sys_channel_account` lifecycle does not.
  - ADR-0023 §4.
  - ADR-0024 §3–§4.
  - ADR-0097 §3 and its "Open / enterprise line".
- **`docs/adr/README.md`**, regenerated by `node scripts/adr-index.mjs` (one new row and the summary counts).
- Forced test edits: none.

## Tests

Docs-only diff; no package touched, so no build closure, unit test or typecheck is owed. The derived ADR gate family ran on the final head (see Verification).

## Acceptance notes

- **Governing text, re-checked on `origin/main` at `0ea90c7a`.**
  - `git grep -n "deliberately omits OAuth2" origin/main -- docs/adr/0097-declarative-connector-instances.md` matches line 119: "The open tier deliberately omits OAuth2 from `ConnectorInstanceAuthSchema`."
  - `git grep -n "intentionally absent" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/shared/connector-auth.zod.ts` answers **nothing**, but the sentence is still in the file: it wraps across lines 113-114 ("OAuth2 is intentionally" / "absent (enterprise tier, ADR-0015)."). A one-line grep cannot match it. The ADR says so and names which surface each schema serves: `ConnectorOAuth2Schema` (L30-40, inside the runtime union `ConnectorAuthConfigSchema` L79-85) vs `ConnectorInstanceAuthSchema` (L158-163, authored, four static kinds).
- **file:line readings behind the ADR's citations** (at `0ea90c7a`). The ADR itself cites `path#symbol`, because `check:adr-symbol-anchors` refuses line anchors in `docs/adr/**`.
  - `connector-auth.zod.ts`: L35 and L38 inline `clientSecret` / `refreshToken`; L99-102 `ResolvedConnectorAuth`.
  - `credential-resolver.ts`: L12, L21-22.
  - `service-automation/src/plugin.ts`: L1955 resolver pick, L1997 resolve at materialization, L2306-2337 `resolveInstanceAuth` (static kinds only).
  - `connector-mcp/src/mcp-provider.ts`: L63-79 `applyAuthToHeaders`, L115.
  - `connector-openapi/src/openapi-connector.ts`: L52 and L88-93 (`securitySchemes` typed, never read), L365 `applyAuth`.
  - `connector-rest/src/rest-connector.ts`: L89.
  - `integration/connector.zod.ts`: L1168-1192 `DeclarativeConnectorEntrySchema` (inline-secret refusal).
  - `sys-account.object.ts`: L183-187 (`user_id` required), L236-255 (token columns `textarea` + `internal`, not `secret`).
  - `auth-schema-config.ts`: L124 `AUTH_ACCOUNT_CONFIG`.
  - `auth-plugin.ts`: L557 `socialProviders`.
  - `auth-manager-plugin-list.ts`: L478-488 (oauth-provider).
  - `connector-imap/src/account.ts`: L60, L68-69 (`MailCredentialProvider`).
- **Premise finding.** ADR-0015 contains neither "OAuth" nor "enterprise" (`grep -c -i enterprise` = 0). The enterprise placement was first drawn for connectors by ADR-0018 line 229, then repeated by 0022, 0023, 0024 and 0097. The ADR-0015 note therefore corrects the attribution and changes no decision.
- **ADR-0018 line 229** also places "OAuth2 token refresh" in the enterprise tier. The seat's claim amendment 6449956947 added that file to the surface, so it carries the sixth note, and ADR-0143 lists it under Amends.
- **Not in this PR:** card item 3, the cloud-repository record with a `## Provenance` pointer. This lane cannot reach the cloud repository. ADR-0143's Provenance section records that the boundary was only ever drawn in this repository (no `cloud ADR` citation in any of the six records) and that the cloud record is owed.
- **Tier H.** This PR is a draft and waits for an approval from an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`. The seat does not ready it, arm auto-merge or enqueue it.
